description: Post-integration spec sync and worktree ergonomics
changelog: Move spec out of the task execution plane: code tasks emit spec-delta and cannot merge .phronia/spec; integrate refuses SPEC_IN_CODE_TASK; phronia task spec plan|commit applies the delta after landing under the integration lock. Resolve archive branches from the worktree registry or landed integration metadata. Clarify dispatch next steps for multi-session work, add parallel launch, declarative worktree inputs and explicit ignored_inputs, dependency/build hints, cleanup size, and doctor/parallel status spec visibility.
